# Vendor Template Descriptions

This document provides detailed descriptions of the 4 pre-built templates available for vendors.

---

## 1. Minimal Template

**Slug**: `minimal`  
**Category**: Minimal  
**Default**: Yes  
**Version**: 1.0.0

### Description
A clean, simple template with plenty of white space. Perfect for showcasing products with a modern, uncluttered aesthetic. This template emphasizes simplicity and lets your products speak for themselves.

### Design Characteristics
- **Color Scheme**: Black and white with subtle grays
- **Typography**: Inter (modern sans-serif)
- **Layout**: Spacious with generous padding
- **Product Cards**: Minimal design with essential information only
- **Hero Banner**: Simple, clean banner with minimal text overlay

### Best For
- Modern, minimalist brands
- Fashion and apparel
- Tech products
- Artisan goods
- Brands that value simplicity

### Key Features
- 4-column product grid
- Minimal product cards (image, name, price)
- Clean navigation bar
- White background with subtle borders
- 8px border radius on cards

### Customization Options
- Primary color (default: black)
- Secondary color (default: gray)
- Font selection
- Grid columns (2-6)
- Card border radius

---

## 2. Elegant Template

**Slug**: `elegant`  
**Category**: Elegant  
**Default**: No  
**Version**: 1.0.0

### Description
A sophisticated template with refined typography and rich colors. Ideal for luxury brands and premium products. This template exudes class and elegance with its serif fonts and gold accents.

### Design Characteristics
- **Color Scheme**: Deep navy blue with gold accents
- **Typography**: Playfair Display (headings) and Lora (body) - elegant serif fonts
- **Layout**: Generous spacing with refined proportions
- **Product Cards**: Detailed cards with ratings and descriptions
- **Hero Banner**: Full-width banner with elegant overlay

### Best For
- Luxury brands
- Premium products
- Jewelry and accessories
- High-end fashion
- Fine art and collectibles

### Key Features
- 3-column product grid (more spacious)
- Detailed product cards with ratings
- Sticky navigation bar
- Cream/beige background
- 12px border radius on cards
- Gold accent color for CTAs

### Customization Options
- Primary color (default: deep navy)
- Accent color (default: gold)
- Font pairing
- Section padding
- Card detail level

---

## 3. Bold Template

**Slug**: `bold`  
**Category**: Bold  
**Default**: No  
**Version**: 1.0.0

### Description
A vibrant, eye-catching template with strong contrasts and dynamic layouts. Perfect for brands that want to stand out. This template uses bold colors and modern fonts to create an energetic, attention-grabbing design.

### Design Characteristics
- **Color Scheme**: Vibrant orange primary with blue secondary and yellow accent
- **Typography**: Montserrat (headings) and Open Sans (body) - bold, modern fonts
- **Layout**: Dynamic with split hero banner
- **Product Cards**: Detailed cards with ratings
- **Hero Banner**: Split layout with image and text side-by-side

### Best For
- Youth-oriented brands
- Sports and fitness
- Entertainment
- Creative industries
- Brands that want to make a statement

### Key Features
- 4-column product grid
- Detailed product cards
- Sticky navigation with bold color
- Split hero banner layout
- 16px border radius (more rounded)
- High contrast color scheme

### Customization Options
- Primary color (default: vibrant orange)
- Secondary color (default: deep blue)
- Accent color (default: yellow)
- Banner style
- Card border radius

---

## 4. Colorful Template

**Slug**: `colorful`  
**Category**: Colorful  
**Default**: No  
**Version**: 1.0.0

### Description
A playful, energetic template with multiple accent colors and fun design elements. Great for creative and lifestyle brands. This template uses a colorful palette to create a cheerful, approachable design.

### Design Characteristics
- **Color Scheme**: Purple primary, green secondary, yellow accent
- **Typography**: Poppins (headings) and Nunito (body) - friendly, rounded fonts
- **Layout**: Balanced with good spacing
- **Product Cards**: Detailed cards with ratings
- **Hero Banner**: Full-width banner with colorful overlay

### Best For
- Creative brands
- Lifestyle products
- Children's products
- Art supplies
- Fun, approachable brands

### Key Features
- 4-column product grid
- Detailed product cards
- Top navigation with colorful background
- Light gray background
- 20px border radius (very rounded)
- Multiple accent colors

### Customization Options
- Primary color (default: purple)
- Secondary color (default: green)
- Accent color (default: yellow)
- Font selection
- Card border radius
- Background color

## Template Selection Guide

### Choose Minimal If:
- You want a clean, professional look
- Your products speak for themselves
- You prefer simplicity over decoration
- You target modern, design-conscious customers

### Choose Elegant If:
- You sell luxury or premium products
- You want a sophisticated, refined appearance
- You value traditional elegance
- You target high-end customers

### Choose Bold If:
- You want to stand out and make an impact
- Your brand is energetic and dynamic
- You target younger demographics
- You want a modern, attention-grabbing design

### Choose Colorful If:
- Your brand is fun and approachable
- You want a cheerful, positive vibe
- You sell creative or lifestyle products
- You want to appeal to a broad audience

---

## Customization Tips

### Color Customization
- **Minimal**: Keep it monochrome or add one accent color
- **Elegant**: Use rich, deep colors with metallic accents
- **Bold**: Use high-contrast, vibrant colors
- **Colorful**: Use a harmonious color palette with 2-3 main colors

### Font Pairing
- **Minimal**: Stick with one font family (sans-serif)
- **Elegant**: Pair serif heading with serif body
- **Bold**: Use bold, modern sans-serif fonts
- **Colorful**: Use friendly, rounded fonts

### Layout Adjustments
- **Minimal**: Keep spacing generous, use 4 columns
- **Elegant**: Use 3 columns for more spacious feel
- **Bold**: Use 4 columns for dynamic grid
- **Colorful**: Use 4 columns for variety

---

## Technical Notes

- All templates are mobile-responsive
- Templates use CSS custom properties for easy customization
- Component variants are mapped per template
- Templates support dark mode (future enhancement)
- All templates are SEO-optimized
